title: Not going: nem before the verb

sections.title: Nem megyek
sections.content: To say that someone is not going, put *nem* right before the verb: *Nem megyek az irodába.* The place keeps its *-ba/-be* ending. *Nem* is the only word you add, and the verb form does not change. *Ma* (“today”) and *most* (“now”) can open the sentence: *Ma nem megyek az iskolába.*

items.english: I am not going to the office.
Anna is not going to the shop.
Today I am not going to school.
You are not going to the park now.

sections.content: *Nem* stands directly in front of the verb, like the *nem* in *Nem vagyok Meg*. It is never joined to the verb, and you do not need a second *nem*: *Nem megyek*, not *nem nem megyek*.
